body.x: Sonic Tier(www.sonictier.com) introduced its UHD 10.2 channel sound production tool at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which runs Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

As UHD channels will be applied in major broadcasting channels next February, Sonic Tier introduced its multi-channel(10.2 ch) audio contents production software "STA UHD Producer" for the first time in the world. It can be installed in a plug-in-play method to Pro Tools and Nuendo, which takes more than 90% of the market share of the world's sound contents production. Successful UHD broadcasting standards adaptation in Korea will affect the UHD standards in China and the US.

Sonic Tier provides realistic sound technology to all devices including cinema, home theater, and laptops. All nine halls in CGV Yeoido and 20 halls in Lotte Cinema and Megabox use Sonic Tier's 16-channel technology, and about 40 films have been mixed with Sonic Tier's 16-channels technology.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
